seo.title: Database client features | TablePro
seo.description: Write queries, edit data, inspect schemas and move data between files and databases. Explore TablePro's free and paid features.

header.title: Features
header.lead: Query, edit and work with data across supported databases.

items.summary: Write SQL with autocomplete, reuse saved queries and search your history. Inspect query plans on supported engines.
Filter rows, follow foreign keys and review edits before saving.
Inspect relationships, change table structure and compare supported databases.
Import {importFormats} files and export tables or results. Open data files without a database connection.
Use your preferred AI provider, or connect an external client through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
Use SSH tunnels and cloud sign-in. Import connections from other apps.
Sync through iCloud or share connections and queries with your team.

ios.title: iPhone and iPad
ios.body: Browse tables, edit rows and run queries on iPhone and iPad. The separate mobile app is free, with no in-app purchases. Feature availability is listed on each detail page.

paid.title: Free and paid
paid.lead: The core app is free, with no trial period. Starter adds paid features to the Mac app; Team includes Starter. All supported databases, the AI assistant, MCP and Safe Mode are available without a license.
